symptom.statement: checkout-svc error rate is high due to payment-svc failures

cause.statement: checkout-svc deployments are failing to update payment-svc configuration

runtime_effect.statement: checkout-svc requests to payment-svc are being rejected due to misconfiguration

parsed.rationale: The checkout-svc error rate spike is directly caused by a configuration change in checkout-svc to use port 18112 for payment-svc, which was not running. This is supported by the commit that changed the config and the deployment of the new checkout-svc version. The payment-svc error rate data shows high error rates, but the root cause is the checkout-svc misconfiguration.
